encounter_greeting.text: oh hi {player}!! are you the big lords army?? im {persona} from {my_faction} and i am very sorry if im in the way :)
stop right there {player}!! i am a menace on this road now, ask anyone. ok maybe not anyone but still. the menace is real
{player}!!! ure so nice to see u, i have no idea where im going but u look like u know the way xD can i follow u??
hello {player} is this the way to the big town?? i think i took a wrong turn somewhere around the rock that looks like a sheep
oh its {player}!! i read about u on the board, u are basically a legend to me now. sorry for staring, im {persona} of {my_faction}

beat_by_player.text: ah i lost!! ur army is so big {player}, i counted like {troop_count} of u?? thats a lot of men, i am proud i survived tho
hi {player} i think u beat us?? sry about the mud, my horses got stuck and i did not know which horn to blow
{player} u won?? that is not fair, u had {troop_count} men and we had like 3 and a dog... well done i guess
{player} that was so fun even tho we lost :) can i buy u a drink when we meet again, i have like 2 coins

released_by_player.text: thank u thank u thank u {player}!!! i thought i was going to be locked up forever, u are the nicest lord ever
{player} let me go!! i am free!! i will never donate grain to anyone else ever again, promise
ummm thanks {player}, i did not know u could just let people go?? i thought only ransom worked. sry for being a bother
{player} u let me go?? i will be a menace to ur road again, just kidding!! mostly. thanks i guess

fought_alongside_player.text: we beat them {player}!!! i hit the horn at the right time i think?? everyone ran so i guess thats a win. thanks for being here
{player} and me just beat {enemy_faction}!! {troop_count} of them ran away, i think they were scared of my horn xD
ur a legend {player}. i did not understand half of what happened but the {enemy_faction} men went home so yay :)

whisper_beg_help.text: {player} pls pls help, {enemy_faction} is at {fief} and i think they are coming to our walls. i would be so grateful :)
hi {player} sry to bug u but {fief} is under threat from {enemy_faction}. do u have any spare men? no pressure!! mostly
{player} u are my favourite lord and im scared, {enemy_faction} is attacking {fief}!! can u come help? i will bring my horn

ambient_lfg.text: LF men!! {my_faction} is going to {fief} to fight {enemy_faction}, anyone can come?? i will be there with my horn xD
does anyone know which horn means charge?? asking for a {my_faction} raid on {fief}, we need bodies, all welcome!!
{my_faction} needs fighters for {fief} vs {enemy_faction} :) no experience needed, i am a newbie and i am still here lol

ambient_chatter.text: is it just me or is the rain in {town} sideways?? my horse keeps slipping and i fell off twice sry
anyone been to {village}? i got lost there for an hour and found 3 chickens and a very confused goat xD
why does my bread taste like the road to {town}?? is that normal or did i do something wrong
lag lag lag, i think my computer is angry at me. anyone else's horse just walked into a wall??

player_joined_my_faction.text: welcome {player}!! ur in {my_faction} now, pls dont donate ur grain to anyone else, i did that once and it was awful
{player} u came to {my_faction}?! i am so happy, ur the first new person i get to say hi to. sry if i ask lots of questions
{player} is in {my_faction} now. i dont know what that means for the horns but welcome i guess?? xD
{player} i still think ur a bit scary but u joined {my_faction} so welcome i guess, dont make me blow the horn at u

encounter_alliance_yes.text: yes yes yes {player}!! an alliance, i have never had one before, do i shake ur hand or bow or both?? sry
sure {player}, we can ally. pls dont let {rival} near me, they looked at my horse funny. ok thanks, sorry for the rambling
{player} accepted!! we are allies now?? i hope {enemy_faction} does not mind, i will bring extra horn sounds for fun xD
alright {player}, allies it is. i will try not to blow the wrong horn at ur men, that is my only promise :)

captured_by_player.text: ok ok {player} u got me, im ur prisoner now. pls dont make me pay {gold}, i only have like 2 coins and a boot
ummm sorry {player}, i was trying to run away and fell in a ditch. im from {my_faction}, pls be gentle with me?? sry
{player} i am so glad it was u who caught me!! is the ransom {gold}? i will pay it, promise, i think i have some grain left
u caught me {player}!! that was a very sneaky move. i demand a rematch, and also {gold} seems like a lot for a boot
